content.text:
Two night wakings at 19 months is really common and usually comes down to a falling-asleep association - if Remy needs you to get back to sleep at bedtime, they'll call for the same thing at 2am. Try putting Remy down drowsy but awake at the start of the night and hold the response to wakings for a few minutes to give them a chance to resettle independently.
